title: SKI adds a local two-way voice loop to popular coding agents
friendlyTitle: SKI lets you talk with your coding assistant out loud
summary: SKI is a free Mac and Windows app that connects voice input and spoken replies to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and other coding agents. Speech recognition and synthesis run on-device, with optional transcript review before instructions reach the agent.
friendlySummary: SKI connects your voice to coding tools such as Codex and Claude Code, then reads their answers aloud. Its main speech features run on your own computer.
whyItMatters: A hands-free conversation can help with accessibility, pair-programming and working through ideas away from the keyboard. Local speech processing limits audio exposure, while approve-before-send mode gives users a chance to correct a transcription before an agent acts on it.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Voice can make coding tools easier to use when typing is difficult or inconvenient. You can check the written instruction before sending it to avoid mistakes.
